passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Reduce ritual by one step each week

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Maintain one authentic trait across ALL social contexts today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Attend one social event for just 30 minutes

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Share one genuine opinion in a group conversation

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Treat everyone equally for one social event regardless of status

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Deliberately miss one event and practice JOMO (joy of missing out)

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Redirect one gossip conversation to something constructive

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Practice gradual disclosure — match the other person's depth

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Post something and don't check engagement for 24 hours

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Hold one personal value in a group setting where it's unpopular

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take one private action for a cause you genuinely care about

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Ask directly: 'Can I join?' instead of assuming rejection

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Have one conversation with zero agenda

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Focus on connection rather than comparison in one conversation

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Gently reduce one obligation-based relationship

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Share something real in a small group setting

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Break the cycle: if pursuing, pause. If distancing, lean in.

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Practice being WITH someone in pain without fixing

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Stay consistent: medium warmth is better than extreme swings
